Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1928

Report for the Year 1928 and Budget for the Year 1929
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1929

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the figures printed on charts, the staff and pension lists, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, maps and graphs without printed figures, and the index are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages and long schedules by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (13 cells). Chapters follow the printed contents.
